marketing.$description: Marketing mode. Declared on :root but read only under [data-mode="marketing"] (@nexub/themes/marketing), so apps don't change. Built from palette tones and roles, so dark mode, data-contrast and data-product keep working.

hero-ambient.$value: radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 50% at 50% -20%, light-dark(rgb(64 153 241 / 0.12), rgb(64 153 241 / 0.08)) 0%, transparent 60%), radial-gradient(ellipse 60% 40% at 80% 80%, light-dark(rgb(28 206 102 / 0.06), transparent) 0%, transparent 50%)
hero-ambient.$description: Hero backdrop, layered over the page surface

button-gradient.$description: Button variant="hero" (primary tones 45 → 40; 50 fails AA with white text)

button-fg.$description: Text on the hero button gradient (AA on both stops)

button-shadow.$value: 0 14px 30px -12px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-palette-primary-40) 65%, transparent), inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.22)
button-shadow.$description: Hero button glow. At most one glowing button per screen.

button-shadow-hover.$value: 0 20px 36px -12px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-palette-primary-40) 70%, transparent), inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.25)

eyebrow-gradient.$value: linear-gradient(180deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-primary) 4%, var(--color-surface-container-lowest)) 0%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-primary) 10%, var(--color-surface-container-lowest)) 100%)

float-shadow.$description: Floating cards over a hero visual

accent-line.$description: Brand accent line: Nexub and the product colours
